title: Inclusion & Diversity in Youth Work
summary: We invite youth associations to participate in our TC, designed to foster connections and collaboration within the field of inclusion in youth work.

title: CirqueVibe - Circus for Well-being and Inclusion in Youth Work
summary: This training of trainers is organized as a part of the CirqueVibe project that brings together circus pedagogy and social work with focus on marginalized youth (18-25 years of age).

title: ScreenWriting for Social Change: Tell the Story that Changes the World
summary: Screenwriting for social change: 10-week programme mixing creative writing, personal reflections, filmmaking & group dialogue. Develop your authentic story and create a purpose-driven short film.
participants_from: Erasmus+ Youth Programme countries, Other countries in the world, Partner Countries Neighbouring the EU

title: MindBoost Academy: Mental Health & Youth Work
summary: MindBoost Academy: Mental Health & Youth Work is an Erasmus+ training for youth workers from the Netherlands and Serbia to co-create a practical mental health toolkit while developing skills in resilience, peer support and non-formal education.

title: Partnership Building Activity with Study Visits in the field of Sport
summary: This activity combines study visits and partnership-building sessions for organisations using sport to promote social inclusion. Participants will exchange good practices, build international partnerships and explore future Erasmus+ Sport projects.
participants_from: Eastern Partnership countries, Erasmus+ Youth Programme countries, Southern Mediterranean countries, Western Balkan countries

title: Democracy Reloading Webinars 2026: Developing youth participation in municipal decisions
summary: Four 90-minute webinars focusing on the four key competences for municipalities in developing youth participation in municipal decisions.
participants_from: United Kingdom, Eastern Partnership countries, Erasmus+ Youth Programme countries, Southern Mediterranean countries, Western Balkan countries

title: Dive into Youth Participation
summary: A training course for youth workers and youth leaders who want to strengthen quality youth participation, explore Erasmus+ Youth Participation Activities (KA154), and develop projects that empower young people to take an active role in democratic life.
participants_from: Erasmus+ Youth Programme countries, Western Balkan countries

title: From Idea to Impact - An Erasmus+ Youth and European Solidarity Corps Project Lab for Deaf and hard-of-hearing people and organisations
summary: Do you have a youth project idea and want Erasmus+ or European Solidarity Corps funding? Get support to develop it, choose the right format, and meaningfully involve Deaf or hard-of-hearing people.

title: Training of Trainers on Being Civically Engaged
summary: Join the certified and ETS-aligned course to strengthen trainers' competencies in being civically engaged, focusing on the civic role of the trainer, integrating values and beliefs, critical thinking, and democracy and human rights principles.

title: Heritage Revised — New Media Approaches to Heritage Awareness in Youth Work
summary: In Heritage Revised, youth trainers will experiment with VR, AR, 360° storytelling, interactive projection, digital storytelling, gamification and AI-supported creative tools.

title: Youth+: How to help youth with fewer/less opportunities grow in volunteering projects
summary:
An online course for youth workers to learn: 
- how to approach a group of youth with fewer opportunities,
- how to involve them, to create their own volunteering project to help a community in need,
- how to train, coach, mentor and support them.
participants_from: Erasmus+ Youth Programme countries, Other countries in the world, Partner Countries Neighbouring the EU

title: Ladder to Inclusion - Create Safer International Mobilities for Highly Vulnerable Young People Online Course
summary: How can international youth mobility become truly safe, inclusive, and empowering for Highly Vulnerable Young People? This self-paced course equips youth workers with practical tools, trauma-informed approaches, and safeguarding competencies for mobility.
